title: Non-compliance with Commission orders
description: Failure to comply with orders made by the District, State, or National Commission

content.offence: Whoever fails to comply with any order made by the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission
content.punishment: Imprisonment for a term of one month to three years, or fine of twenty-five thousand rupees to one lakh rupees, or both
